newsitem.title: UK: Moody's has no comment on Turkey downgrade talk.
newsitem.headline: Moody's has no comment on Turkey downgrade talk.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service has no comment on talk in markets that it is set to downgrade Turkey's sovereign ratings soon, an official for the rating agency said on Friday.
Stockbrokers in Istanbul said earlier on Friday they expected Moody's to release a statement on Turkey's rating soon.
Turkish markets have been swirling with rumours of an immiment Moody's downgrading for some weeks.
The rating agency last month put Turkey's Ba3 long-term foreign currency rating and its B1 foreign currency bank deposit ceiling on review for possible downgrade.
The Moody's official reiterated on Friday that the agency's position on this had not changed. But he had no comment on whether a ratings action was imminent.
